chapters.title: VOLUME ONE: NAME THAT CHORD
chapters.notes: Triads, 7th chords, TBN I and TBN II in Close & Spread voicings across 6 cycles through C Major, C Melodic Minor, and C Harmonic Minor.

chapters.title: VOLUME TWO: DO NOT NAME THAT CHORD
chapters.notes: 3-part 4ths (Close & Spread), 4-part 4ths (6 voicing types), and Spread Cluster (6 voicing types), across 6 cycles through C Major, C Melodic Minor, and C Harmonic Minor.
